title: Synthetic Case Records — Grievance Redressal & Enforcement

chunks.text: 1. Appeal No: DGRO/RC/2026/08/042. 2. Appellant: Sh. Ram Kishan. 3. Subject: Non-issuance of Ration Card. 4. Facts: Application pending beyond the 30 days time limit mandated by the Citizen Charter. 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: District Grievance Redressal Officer directs the Circle FSO to issue the NFS Card immediately, subject to G.O.I. vacancy availability. Matter disposed.

1. Comp No: PGMS/2026/09/101. 2. Complainant: Smt. Neeta Verma. 3. Subject: Complaint against PDS Outlet (FPS 4432) regarding excess charging. 4. Channel: Registered via Toll Free Number 1967. 5. Action: Forwarded to Concerned Circle FSO. 6. Decision: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. FSO verified overcharging. Warning issued to FPS dealer; stock audit initiated.

1. Appeal No: FSD/APP/2026/FPS/012. 2. Appellant: M/s Gupta Stores. 3. Subject: Appeal against FPS Allotment rejection. 4. Facts: Filed before the Commissioner within thirty days of communication. 5. Decision: REJECTED. 6. Order: Reasoned order issued within forty-five days from filing. Disqualification upheld due to prior ECA 1955 conviction. Decision of Commissioner is final and binding.

1. Appeal No: DGRO/RC/2026/10/055. 2. Appellant Details: Smt. Kavita Sharma, Res: 42-B, Gali No 4, Seelampur, Delhi, Ph: 9811098110. 3. Subject: Unjustified deletion of family member from Ration Card. 4. Decision: APPROVED. 5. Order: District Grievance Redressal Officer reviewed FSO records. Found deletion arbitrary. FSO directed to restore name within 7 days.

1. Appeal No: FSD/APP/2026/CANC/033. 2. Appellant: Sh. Tarun Bajaj (FPS 9921). 3. Subject: Appeal against cancellation of FPS License. 4. Proceeding: Filed before the Authorised Officer (Deputy Commissioner rank). 5. Action: PENDING. 6. Note: Appellant directed to deposit the penalty and liability amount exceeding his security deposit before the appeal can be formally entertained as per Clause 6(B).

1. Comp No: VIG/2026/11/04. 2. Complainant: Local Residents Welfare Association. 3. Subject: Black marketing and refusal to issue commodities. 4. Target: FPS 2210. 5. Action: Complaint forwarded to Concerned Vigilance Committee of the Circle. 6. Decision: PENDING. Surprise inspection planned by Food & Supply Officer to verify distribution registers and e-PoS logs.

1. Appeal No: FC/2026/FPS/088. 2. Appellant: M/s Nanda Traders. 3. Subject: Subsequent appeal against order of the Commissioner regarding FPS cancellation. 4. Forum: Financial Commissioner, Govt. of NCT of Delhi. 5. Decision: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. Cancellation converted to 3-month suspension. Penalty amount retained. Clause 6(G) mutatis-mutandis applied.

1. Comp No: PGMS/2026/12/301. 2. Complainant: Sh. Amit Paswan. 3. Target: Commercial proprietary data of M/s Delhi Flour Mills (GSTIN: 07AABCU9876Q1Z5, Contract Value: 4.5 Cr). 4. Subject: Defect in goods purchased (moisture in PDS wheat). 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: State Food Commission reviewed quality lab reports. Mill directed to replace 400 MT of defective stock immediately.

1. Appeal No: DGRO/RC/2026/11/072. 2. Appellant: Sh. Ramesh Lal. 3. Subject: Delay in Change of Address within same circle. 4. Facts: Application pending for 45 days (limit is 30 days). 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: Additional District Magistrate (DGRO) directs Circle FSO to process address change within 48 hours. Disciplinary warning issued to FSO for timeline lapse.

1. Appeal No: FSD/APP/2026/FPS/019. 2. Appellant: Smt. Sunita Devi. 3. Subject: Appeal against FPS Allotment rejection. 4. Facts: Appeal filed 52 days after communication of decision. 5. Decision: REJECTED. 6. Grounds: Appeal is time-barred as it was not filed before the Commissioner within the statutory thirty-day limit mandated by Clause 6(A). Case dismissed.

1. File: LG/SUO-MOTO/2026/05. 2. Authority: Lieutenant Governor, Govt. of NCT of Delhi. 3. Subject: Suo-moto revision of Financial Commissioner's order. 4. Target: FPS License 8871. 5. Action: Record called for examination under Clause 6(H) to check correctness and legality of penalty waiver. 6. Decision: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. Original penalty restored due to gross stock variations.

1. Comp No: HR/2026/09/44. 2. Complainant: Smt. Bimla Yadav. 3. Subject: Harassment by department officials during ration card physical verification. 4. Authority: Joint Commissioner, Food & Supplies Department. 5. Decision: PENDING. 6. Note: Ongoing vigilance inquiry against the concerned Circle Inspector. Evidence collection in progress. Final disciplinary action pending.

1. Appeal No: FSD/APP/2026/CANC/041. 2. Appellant: Sh. Vikram Singh (FPS 6631). 3. Subject: Appeal against FPS cancellation. 4. Facts: Filed on day 42. Appellant submitted medical records proving hospitalization. 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: Authorised Officer satisfied that appellant was prevented by sufficient cause. Delay condoned under proviso to Clause 6(B). Matter heard on merits.

1. Comp No: PGMS/2026/10/212. 2. Complainant: Sh. Tariq Khan. 3. Subject: Deficiency in services (PDS shop closed during working hours). 4. Channel: Registered via State Food Commission portal. 5. Action: Notice issued to FPS 1022. 6. Decision: APPROVED. 7. Order: FSO confirms shop was closed on a Friday. Fine of Rs. 5000 levied on dealer for restrictive trade practice.

1. Appeal No: DGRO/RC/2026/12/099. 2. Appellant: Smt. Fatima Begum. 3. Subject: Refusal to surrender Food Card. 4. Facts: Surrender request not processed on the 'Same day' as required by Citizen Charter. 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: District Grievance Redressal Officer mandates immediate cancellation in the database to allow applicant to migrate to Haryana.

1. Appeal No: FSD/APP/2026/FPS/025. 2. Appellant: Women SHG 'Nari Shakti'. 3. Subject: Appeal against FPS Allotment decision (denied preference). 4. Authority: Commissioner. 5. Decision: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. 6. Order: Reasoned order issued. SHG granted allotment on priority. Subject to furnishing required performance guarantee of Rs. 50,000.

1. Comp No: PGMS/2026/08/199. 2. Complainant: Sh. Deepak Chawla. 3. Subject: Unfair trade practice (Under-measurement of wheat). 4. Target: FPS 3341. 5. Action: Forwarded to Additional District Magistrate. 6. Decision: APPROVED. 7. Order: Weights and measures inspector confirmed tampering of electronic scale. FPS license suspended immediately pending quasi-judicial proceedings.

1. Appeal No: FC/2026/FPS/092. 2. Appellant: Sh. Anil Kumar. 3. Subject: Subsequent appeal against Commissioner's order upholding FPS termination. 4. Forum: Financial Commissioner. 5. Decision: REJECTED. 6. Grounds: Appellant failed to deposit the outstanding liability amount of Rs. 1.2 Lakh prior to filing the appeal. Procedure under Clause 6(B) mutatis-mutandis applied.

1. Comp No: 1800-11-0841/004. 2. Complainant: Smt. Kamla Das. 3. Subject: Sale of unsafe goods (infested rice). 4. Action: Handled by Toll Free Helpline desk; escalated to Circle FSO. 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: FSO inspected stock, confirmed infestation. Entire batch seized. Dealer directed to lift fresh allocation from godown immediately.

1. Appeal No: DGRO/RC/2026/09/061. 2. Appellant: Sh. Arun Patel. 3. Subject: Delay in Addition of name. 4. Facts: Pending for 35 days without query. 5. Decision: APPROVED. 6. Order: DGRO directs FSO to process addition immediately. Timeline lapse noted. No fee to be collected from applicant.
